title: Security Vulnerability: Input Validation Bypass
summary: A security vulnerability was identified where user input containing URL-encoded characters could bypass validation checks, potentially leading to CRLF injection and other attacks.
root_cause: Lack of comprehensive input validation on router query parameters
resolution: Added comprehensive input validation to router query parameters across the codebase
impact_description: Potential for CRLF injection and other attacks, potentially leading to privilege escalation attempts and data breaches
